issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Inferock Bench
products.tagline: An independent receipt for every LLM API call
products.summaryZh: 每次LLM API调用均有独立收据
products.descriptionZh: Inferock-bench 是一个本地代理，位于你的应用与 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 或 OpenRouter 格式的调用之间。它捕获每次调用的令牌使用量、失败和重试情况，然后生成独立的收据，显示你被收取的费用以及实际多付了多少。
products.description: Inferock-bench is a local proxy that sits between your app and OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or OpenRouter shaped calls. It captures per-call token usage, failures, and retries, then generates an independent receipt showing what you were billed and how much you're actually overpaying for.

products.name: GLM-5.3
products.tagline: Coding leap from scaled post-training on the same base
products.summaryZh: 基于同一基座的大规模后训练实现编码能力跃升
products.descriptionZh: GLM-5.3是Z.ai最新推出的模型，专为复杂、长期编码任务而设计。通过大规模后训练扩展，它在代理编码方面达到了开源领域的顶尖水平，并在漏洞发现和网络防御方面展现出新兴能力。
products.description: GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's latest model built for complex, long-horizon coding tasks. Through massive post-training scaling, it achieves open-source SOTA in agentic coding and demonstrates emergent capabilities in vulnerability discovery and cyber defense.

products.name: Big Mike
products.tagline: Your favorite uncle who knows sports & bets, on iMessage
products.summaryZh: 你在iMessage上那位懂体育又懂博彩的叔叔
products.descriptionZh: Big Mike整天阅读MLB、NFL/CFB和NBA/WNBA的资讯，并通过iMessage给你发来投注建议：该押什么、赔率是多少、哪家博彩公司有。七月战绩：115胜68负，+21.4个单位。每项推荐都公开评级，输的从不删除。球星缺阵？交易变动？他会告诉你这对盘口有何影响。把他拉进群聊，整个团队都能同时听到。提醒一句：他喜欢挑起话题。关联你的Sleeper或ESPN联赛，首发/替补建议将针对你的阵容。问Big Mike吧。
products.description: Big Mike reads MLB, NFL/CFB, and NBA/WNBA all day and texts you the play in iMessage: what to bet, at what number, and which book has it. July Record: 115-68, +21.4 units. Every pick graded in public, no deleted losers. Star ruled out? Trade drops? He texts you what it does to the line. Add him to the group chat and the whole crew hears it at once. Fair warning: he stirs up banter. Link your Sleeper or ESPN league and the start/sit calls are about your roster. Ask Big Mike.

products.name: Zetik
products.tagline: A chief of staff in your pocket
products.summaryZh: 口袋里的参谋长
products.descriptionZh: 总统和CEO有战略团队。你呢……只能刷焦虑？认识一下Zetik：一支AI代理团队，全天候运行完整情报周期——收集、筛选、分析、简报——覆盖播客、论文、代码、推文和新闻。它近乎实时追踪一切对你重要的事情。
products.description: Presidents and CEOs get strategy teams. You get… doomscrolling? Meet Zetik: an AI agent team running a full intelligence cycle — collect, filter, analyze, brief — across podcasts, papers, code, tweets & news, 24/7. It tracks whatever matters to you, in near real time.

products.name: Attyn
products.tagline: Bringing intelligence to your cursor
products.summaryZh: 为您的光标注入智能
products.descriptionZh: Attyn将智能带入您已使用的应用中的光标。通过Inline Assist改写选中文本，借助Realtime Dictation说出完成的话语，利用Screen Assist询问屏幕上的内容，并通过Blackboard将问题转化为视觉解释。使用Attyn积分、携带提供商密钥，或运行受支持的本地模型。Attyn是自筹资金且独立的。现已支持macOS，Windows版本即将推出。每个新账户初始赠送500个启动积分。
products.description: Attyn brings intelligence to the cursor inside the apps you already use. Rewrite selected text with Inline Assist, speak finished words with Realtime Dictation, ask about what is on screen with Screen Assist, and turn questions into visual explanations with Blackboard. Use Attyn Credits, bring a provider key, or run a supported local model. Attyn is bootstrapped and independent. Available for macOS today, with Windows on the way. Every new account starts with 500 launch credits.

products.name: nenspace
products.tagline: the lo-fi of LLMs: your mind, made larger
products.summaryZh: LLM的低保真：你的心智，被放大
products.descriptionZh: nenspace。一个延伸的心智，而非第二个大脑：属于你自己的，被放大的心智。低保真的大语言模型，融合进一个捕捉你的思绪并培育它们的空间：工作记忆、任务、笔记、习惯、日志。与AI融合，但不强加。你的头脑大约能容纳四件事。nenspace容纳其余。免费开始 · 网页 + iOS
products.description: nenspace. an extended mind, not a second brain: your own, made larger. the lo-fi of LLMs fused with the one space that catches your thoughts and cultivates them: working memory, tasks, notes, habits, logbook. AI-fused, but not forced. your head holds about four things. nenspace holds the rest. free to start · web + ios

products.name: Joy
products.tagline: A Mac menu bar app that throws confetti for your wins
products.summaryZh: 一款Mac菜单栏应用，为你的胜利撒彩纸庆祝
products.descriptionZh: Joy是一款macOS菜单栏应用，在你达成里程碑的瞬间——如GitHub星标、Stripe销售、Docker Hub下载量等——便会撒下五彩纸屑。自动庆祝每一个胜利。
products.description: Joy is a macOS menu bar app that throws confetti the moment you hit a milestone - GitHub stars, Stripe sales, Docker Hub pulls, and more. Celebrate every win automatically.

products.name: FileRouter
products.tagline: Take control of files and editors
products.summaryZh: 掌控文件与编辑器。
products.descriptionZh: 一个默认处理器，支持多种文件类型，自动打开正确的编辑器——Velja/Choosy 的文件版。完全控制任何文件类型及其打开的编辑器，支持径向选择器和自定义规则。
products.description: A default handler for multiple file types that opens the right editor — Velja/Choosy for files. Full control of any file type and what editor(s) open it, with radial picker and custom rules.

products.name: Chronock
products.tagline: Scheduling and calendar sync, all in one
products.summaryZh: 日程安排与日历同步，一站式搞定。
products.descriptionZh: Chronock将日程安排与跨日历同步整合于一个工作空间。它能检查已连接的Google和Outlook日历中的可用性，将空闲时间转化为预订页面，并在工作、个人和项目日历之间同步事件，以防止重复预订。访客仅能看到可预订的时间，而你可以在一个集成日历中查看所有已连接的事件。免费开始使用，无需信用卡。
products.description: Chronock combines scheduling and cross-calendar sync in one workspace. It checks availability across connected Google and Outlook calendars, turns open time into a booking page, and syncs events between work, personal, and project calendars to prevent double bookings. Guests see only bookable times, while you can review every connected event in one Integrated Calendar. Start free with no credit card.

products.name: Clamshell
products.tagline: Close your MacBook. Keep the work running.
products.summaryZh: 合上你的MacBook，工作继续。
products.descriptionZh: 过去，合上MacBook就会中断所有正在运行的任务：构建、下载，有时还有执行到一半的代理任务。我开发了Clamshell来解决这个问题。合上盖子，屏幕熄灭，工作继续。无需外接显示器、sudo或管理员设置。
products.description: Closing my MacBook used to kill whatever I had left running: a build, a download, sometimes an agent halfway through a task. I made Clamshell to fix that. The lid shuts, the screen goes dark, and the work carries on. No monitor, sudo, or admin setup.

products.name: Agent Orchestrator
products.tagline: Your coding agent fleet manager
products.summaryZh: 你的编程代理舰队管理器
products.descriptionZh: AO帮助你在一个地方管理所有编码代理。通过看板视图监控整个代理集群，每个任务从进行中到拉取请求、运行测试再到代码审查。使用项目专属编排器规划路线图。让编排器分解任务，将其委派给隔离代理，并为你管理集群。不再需要在代理终端之间切换标签页。开始编排吧。免费开源，遵循Apache 2.0许可。
products.description: AO helps you manage all your coding agents in a single place. Monitor your whole agent fleet on a kanban view as each task goes from working to PR to Running tests to Code Review. Plan the roadmap with your project specific orchestrator. Let the orchestrator breakdown tasks, delegate them to isolated agents, and manage the fleet for you. Stop tab switching between agent terminals. Start orchestrating. Free and open source under Apache 2.0.

products.name: Nick Launches
products.tagline: Launch your product to thousands of builders.
products.summaryZh: 将您的产品推向成千上万的开发者。
products.descriptionZh: Nick Launches帮助开发者通过实用教程、Launch Toolkit、AI工具评测和发布策略，更快地构建并推出AI产品。
products.description: Nick Launches helps developers build and launch AI products faster with practical tutorials, Launch Toolkit, AI tool reviews, and launch strategies.

products.name: Mermail
products.tagline: Your AI can now sign up and pay
products.summaryZh: 你的AI现在可以注册并支付了。
products.descriptionZh: Mermail让AI代理超越聊天，实现更多功能。它提供了代理与真实在线服务交互所需的身份、通信和支付基础设施。通过MCP、Skills或CLI连接，即可让代理安全地验证账户、接收邮件、完成结账和管理订阅。
products.description: Mermail helps AI agents do more than chat. It provides the identity, communication, and payment infrastructure they need to interact with real online services. Connect via MCP, Skills, or the CLI to let your agent verify accounts, receive emails, complete checkouts, and manage subscriptions securely.

products.name: Supercut - AI Video Editor
products.tagline: Type the edit. Record your screen. Zero uploads.
products.summaryZh: 输入编辑内容。录制你的屏幕。零上传。
products.descriptionZh: 两扇前门：拖入片段即可输入编辑，或录制屏幕并在每次点击时自动缩放。40种工具、自动字幕、文件夹批量编辑、时间线、4K桌面导出。全部在你的设备上完成。你的素材永不上传。免费开始，无需账户。
products.description: Two front doors: drop a clip and type the edit, or record your screen with auto-zoom on every click. 40 tools, auto captions, folder batch edits, a timeline, 4K desktop export. All on your device. Your footage never uploads. Free to start, no account needed.

products.name: PodRacer: Manage your iPod on Linux.
products.tagline: 100% offline, open source, systemd free.
products.summaryZh: 100%离线，开源，无需systemd。
products.descriptionZh: 在Linux上向iPod加载音乐确实很糟糕。当然，你可以把音乐塞进去，但这会破坏你的资料库数据库。即便你通过Wine运行iTunes，那也还是iTunes。PodRacer让你加载音乐、编辑标签，甚至自动转换FLAC格式。检查重复文件，备份你的iPod等等。
products.description: loading musing to your ipod on linux really sucks. Sure you can chuck your music into it but it wrecks your library database. and even if you get itunes running under Wine? It's still Itunes. PodRacer lets you load your music, edit tags, and even auto-converts flac. Check for duplicates, back up your ipod, etc.

products.name: ilolink
products.tagline: The registry your team's AI agents actually read
products.summaryZh: 你的团队AI智能体实际读取的注册表
products.descriptionZh: ilolink是一个注册表，用于记录代理生成的内容——技能、规格、计划、运行手册、交接文档。从任何仓库推送一次；每位队友的助手（Claude、Claude Code、ChatGPT——任何MCP客户端）都能读取同一套经过版本管理和审查的内容。个人使用免费。五人团队一次性支付9美元。
products.description: ilolink is a registry for what agents produce — skills, specs, plans, runbooks, handoffs. Push once from any repo; every teammate's assistant (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT — any MCP client) reads the same versioned, reviewed set. Free solo. $9 once for a team of five.

products.name: AutoHDMI - Auto Switch to HDMI
products.tagline: Auto switch Google TV to HDMI input after a power cut
products.summaryZh: 断电后自动将Google TV切换至HDMI输入。
products.descriptionZh: AutoHDMI可在完全重启或断电后，自动将兼容的Android TV和Google TV设备切换到您选择的HDMI输入。对于主要使用机顶盒、游戏机、PC或外部流媒体设备，且不希望每次电视启动时手动切换输入的用户，此功能非常实用。只需设置一次，选择您的HDMI输入，即可让电视自动切换。
products.description: AutoHDMI automatically switches compatible Android TV and Google TV devices to your chosen HDMI input after a full restart or power cut. It is useful for people who mainly use a set-top box, console, PC, or external streaming device and do not want to manually change inputs every time the TV boots. Set it up once, choose your HDMI input, and let the TV switch automatically.

products.name: ResearchMaster AI
products.tagline: Market research for product decisions you can verify.
products.summaryZh: 用于产品决策的市场研究，结果可验证。
products.descriptionZh: ResearchMaster将产品、公司、URL、文件或市场问题转化为结构化的研究空间。它在专业来源中搜索，将主张与证据关联，尽可能突出来源冲突，并将发现转化为可导出的报告和幻灯片，用于产品、竞争对手、市场和可行性决策。
products.description: ResearchMaster turns a product, company, URL, file, or market question into a structured research workspace. It searches across professional sources, keeps claims linked to evidence, highlights source conflicts where possible, and turns the findings into export-ready reports and slides for product, competitor, market, and feasibility decisions.

products.name: Leadline V3
products.tagline: Find B2B buyers already asking Reddit for what you sell
products.summaryZh: 在Reddit上找到已经在询问你所售产品的B2B买家
products.descriptionZh: Leadline能从Reddit上找到已经在寻找类似你产品或帮助的用户帖子。跟踪关键词和子版块，按购买意图和匹配度对每个机会进行排序，并将所有对话集中在一个收件箱中。Leadline还能根据完整帖子草拟回复，但最终发布什么由你决定。不再手动搜索Reddit。在对话仍活跃时找到合适的讨论。
products.description: Leadline finds Reddit posts from people already looking for products or help like yours. Track keywords and subreddits, rank each opportunity by buyer intent and fit, and keep every conversation in one inbox. Leadline can also draft a reply from the full thread, but you decide what gets posted. Stop searching Reddit by hand. Find the right conversation while it is still active.

products.name: Talvo
products.tagline: Connect 2,500+ European banks to track your spending
products.summaryZh: 连接2，500多家欧洲银行，追踪您的消费。
products.descriptionZh: 欧洲货币追踪与预算应用。通过PSD2连接2500多家银行，自动分类每笔交易，追踪预算与净资产。数据托管于欧盟，原生符合GDPR。
products.description: The European money tracker & budgeting app. Connect 2,500+ banks via PSD2, auto-categorise every transaction, track budgets & net worth. EU-hosted, GDPR native.
